# truenas_ups_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS UPS service configuration. This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one UPS configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls ups.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place). monpwd is write-only: it is never read back from TrueNAS and is not stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_ups_config" "config" {
  identifier = "ups"
  mode       = "MASTER"
  driver     = "usbhid-ups$PROTECT UPS"
  port       = "auto"
  shutdown   = "BATT"
  monuser    = "upsmon"
  monpwd     = var.ups_password
}

variable "ups_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Description of the UPS configuration.
- `driver` (String) UPS driver to use.
- `extrausers` (String) Extra users allowed to monitor the UPS, appended to upsd.users.
- `hostsync` (Number) Seconds to wait for the master to shut down before a slave shuts down.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the UPS.
- `mode` (String) UPS mode: MASTER or SLAVE.
- `monpwd` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password used to monitor the UPS (never read back from TrueNAS). Write-only: never stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform >= 1.11.
- `monuser` (String) Username used to monitor the UPS.
- `nocommwarntime` (Number) Seconds without UPS communication before a warning is raised, or null/0 for the default.
- `options` (String) Extra ups.conf options, appended verbatim.
- `optionsupsd` (String) Extra upsd.conf options, appended verbatim.
- `port` (String) Port or address the UPS driver connects to.
- `powerdown` (Boolean) Whether the UPS is powered down after shutdown.
- `remotehost` (String) Hostname or IP address of the remote UPS (SLAVE mode).
- `remoteport` (Number) Port of the remote UPS (SLAVE mode).
- `rmonitor` (Boolean) Whether remote monitoring is enabled.
- `shutdown` (String) Condition triggering shutdown: LOWBATT or BATT.
- `shutdowncmd` (String) Command executed to shut down the system, or null/empty for the default.
- `shutdowntimer` (Number) Seconds on battery before shutdown when shutdown is BATT.

### Read-Only

- `complete_identifier` (String) Server-derived, fully-qualified UPS identifier. Read-only: never sent to TrueNAS.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "ups_config".
